rows.provenance_note: The single Greek problem record and single selected solution have clear pairing provenance. The adapted surname is culturally coherent and does not alter the teaching objective.

findings.explanation: The genitive plural has the same written form for «εγγονός» and «εγγονή», so this repeated expression fails to distinguish grandsons from granddaughters and sounds semantically unclear. It appears twice. The surrounding argument still makes the intended meaning and mathematics clear.
findings.suggested_action: In a Greek-language correction, replace both occurrences with an unambiguous expression such as «ίσο αριθμό αγοριών και κοριτσιών» or «ίσο αριθμό εγγονών αρσενικού και θηλυκού φύλου».

findings.explanation: One historical Greek problem variant contains an ESC control character followed by «llipsis» instead of a valid ellipsis command. The last displayed problem is intact and mathematically agrees with the candidate solution, so this is not a defect in the selected derivation or result.
findings.suggested_action: Flag or sanitize the malformed historical variant during dataset maintenance without changing the intact selected problem or solution.
